definition.def: Ideas, attitudes, or reactions that are contrary to each other are completely different from each other.
examples: This view is contrary to the aims of critical social research for a number of reasons. [+ to]
Several of those present, including Weinberger, had contrary information.

definition.def: If you say that something is true contrary to other people's beliefs or opinions, you are emphasizing that it is true and that they are wrong. [emphasis]
examples: Contrary to popular belief, moderate exercise actually decreases your appetite.
Contrary to what you might think, neither man was offended.

definition.def: You use on the contrary when you have just said or implied that something is not true and are going to say that the opposite is true.
examples: It is not an idea around which the community can unite. On the contrary, I see it as one that will divide us.

definition.def: You can use on the contrary when you are disagreeing strongly with something that has just been said or implied, or are making a strong negative reply. [emphasis]
examples: 'People just don't do things like that.'—'On the contrary, they do them all the time.'

definition.def: You can use quite the contrary to emphasize a previous negative statement, or when you are making a strong negative reply. [emphasis]
examples: I'm not a feminist, quite the contrary.
'Are there any signs that he may quit soon?'—'Quite the contrary.'

definition.def: When a particular idea is being considered, evidence or statements to the contrary suggest that this idea is not true or that the opposite is true.
examples: He stuck to his assumption despite growing evidence to the contrary.
Despite repeated assurances to the contrary, they have not ended their nuclear programme.

examples.sentence: It is worth noting that contrary to popular perception, rowers were not slaves but mostly Roman citizens enrolled in the military.
On the contrary, a great deal of empirical evidence shows that pictures interfere in a damaging way with all aspects of learning to read.

Contrary to what you might imagine, the size of the cycle is not determined by the size of the wheels - except in children's cycles - but by the size of the frame.
Contrary to popular belief, procrastination is not due to laziness or poor time management.

Contrary to what many people think, theatres don't hire people to do the programs.
Contrary to popular belief, cane sugar production was never just restricted to large, dedicated plantations owned by rich men.
